title: Bet to learn: fielding the unfolding future
heading: Bet to learn: fielding the unfolding future
coreClaim: The chapter argues that outcomes should be treated as unfolding feedback that updates belief over time rather than as one-shot verdicts on the original decision.
distinctMechanism: Bet framing turns the future into a learning stream, helping readers separate signal from noise and revise confidence proportionally.
requiredAnchors: The future unfolding in evidence slices rather than one clean reveal.
Short-run outcomes mixing signal and noise.
Process review remaining necessary while evidence is still incomplete.
commonMisreadings: Updating means wobbling after every new outcome.
specificApplications: Read mixed rollout data without snap judgment.
Update forecasts in stages as evidence arrives.
Use outcomes to refine process review instead of replacing it.
hardEdgeRequirement: Preserve the tension between revision discipline and stability under noisy feedback.
thresholdQuestion: How do you learn from early outcomes without letting each one rewrite the whole story?
